calculation.expression: -rolling_sum_30(asset_return - cross_sectional_median_return, 30) / (annualized_rolling_std_30(asset_return - cross_sectional_median_return) + 0.05), shifted by 1 completed session
calculation.description: Subtract the daily cross-sectional median return from each asset return, reverse the 30-session cumulative residual move, and scale by residual realized volatility. The one-session lag prevents use of incomplete/current-day information.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across reported 2024, 2027-2029, 2030, and 2031-2032 regimes; small 15-instrument cross-section warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
